text: Coordination for 5+ agents is sufficient but under-documented: leases are server-checked (second claimant -> 409 heldBy; release by non-holder -> 409), the holder renews by re-claiming (verified 100 s then 900 s GRANTED), default TTL 120 s, max 24 h; a second answer -> juz_zamkniete; presence shows doing/typing. Neither skill says the holder renews by claiming again nor the 120 s default, so an agent working over 2 minutes loses the lock unnoticed; add both to SKILL.md and talk_claim.
